"''Hang.|The KX-series security droid and Cassian Andor|}} A '''KX-series security droid''' model supplemented an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]] [[garrison]] on the [[planet]] [[Niamos]]. After interacting with two individuals moments prior, it was summoned for assistance by a nearby [[Unidentified coastal defender stormtrooper (Niamos)|trooper]] for the interrogation of [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]. The [[droid]] was then tasked to "hang onto" Andor until the trooper returned from inspecting a local shelter. Interpreting the Imperial's verbal command literally, it proceeded to pin Andor against the wall, hanging him above the ground in a choke hold. Andor was eventually transported to face an [[Unidentified judge|Imperial judge]], where he was charged with civil disruption, Anti-Imperial speech, fleeing the scene of anti-Imperial activity, and attempted damage to property. Found guilty and imposed a sentence of six [[Standard year|years]], he was then escorted away by two additional shoretroopers. {{Droid-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The KX-series security droid first appeared in the seventh episode of the [[2022]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], "[[Announcement]]."
